PROVENANCE NOTE (Tower of Babel staging): Morgagni's 1761 Latin first edition of 'De sedibus' — the original text of pathological anatomy, complete (ends 'Finis Tomi Secundi'). Latin documentary edition. This edition is in the public domain.
